correctness.rationale: Using Defant's unitary greedy-tail criterion, the package proves the prime tail beginning at \(5\) fills \([1,54/(5\pi^2)]\): the four exceptional prime indices are checked exactly and the source prime-ratio lemma handles the infinite remainder. Adjoining the prime \(3\) yields precisely the two intermediate blocks \(A=[1,164/(15\pi^2)]\) and \(B=[10/9,12/\pi^2]\). Adjoining the prime \(2\), all exponent choices except simultaneous exponent one at \(2\) and \(3\) overlap into \([1,41/(3\pi^2)]\); the remaining fiber is \([25/18,15/\pi^2]\). The Archimedean rational bounds used for every overlap and the final separation were independently rechecked; the gap endpoints are approximately \(1.3847228431\) and \(1.3888888889\).
